objective: Prove the structural statements that the counts of ticket A support: a wall for pure lines if they are shielded, or the local structure by which a three-place line distinguishes the two twists if they are not.
status: Proved by LINE-DETECTOR-20261023-001B-P001 (V1 prose proof; standard-library check of the lemmas on all two-literal tiling placements, of the trichotomy on 329 contradicting configurations with every cylinder certified, and of three certified three-place counterexamples; two controls rejected). In every two-literal tiling world, shared coins included, a configuration contradicts along no class, along the multiples of one primitive class, or along every odd class, because the doubly allowed tiling makes the parity of every closed implication walk the relative twist of its class; so lone lines are pure lines and line events there, and the shared-coin dual-pair failures are genuine. Three-place worlds break the trichotomy (certified configurations of placements 54, 62 and 111; 12 of 30 three-place placements selective on every torus computed), so at three places a lone line is not a line event; lines pure among eight classes still differ across dual pairs. Qualifies the reading of TRIPLE-SHIELD-20261023-001-D001.
title: Proof: the mechanism behind the dual-pair counts
